messages:
Lena Ortiz: heads-up: i've been spot-checking pages for voice and microcopy. several places mix conversational tone with enterprise tone in the same paragraph. can we decide a default and call out exceptions?
Marco Ruiz: good catch. proposal: default = developer-first, concise, active voice. exceptions: legal, billing, and sales-facing content can be more formal. we should add a tiny section to the style guide.
Priya Shah: agree. also noticed inconsistent use of backticks vs italics for feature names in docs. canonical: code/config -> backticks, product features -> Title Case (e.g., Redwood Console), UI labels -> double quotes.
Lena Ortiz: nice. can someone draft the short "Voice rules" snippet and I will add it to /docs/style/voice.md? keep it < 200 words.
Marco Ruiz: i'll draft a short version and include 3 examples (good/bad) + special-case list.
Priya Shah: another problem: internal links — a bunch of pages link to the old glossary slug /glossary/reserved-capacity which 404s after the reorg. we should add redirects and also update in-page links.
Maya Li: I can run a grep for 404 links and open a mass-fix PR. but we should also add redirect rules in netlify/_redirects or our docs router.
docs-ci-bot: Auto: created issue #1128 — "docs: add redirect for /glossary/reserved-capacity -> /glossary/dedicated" (https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/1128).
Lena Ortiz: action: Maya to open PR for link fixes + redirects. Marco to add voice.md. Priya to update the style lint and add a rule for backticks vs italics.
Marco Ruiz: quick draft snippet I'll paste into PR description:
```
Voice rules (short):
- Default voice: developer-first, concise, active.
- Use Title Case for product names on first mention; thereafter use product short name (e.g., Redwood Dedicated -> Dedicated).
- Use backticks for code/config and double quotes for UI labels. Avoid casual synonyms (e.g., flavor) in technical pages.
```
Priya Shah: for the docs linter, let's add two checks: regex to flag 'flavor' and 'reserved_capacity' occurrences, and a rule to prefer backticks when a token contains punctuation like `-` or `_`. i can add these to /tools/docs-lint/rules.
Maya Li: i'll include the grep+sed fix in my PR and a small note to preserve historical search terms by adding metadata synonyms for the new glossary pages. example frontmatter change: `search_synonyms: ["reserved capacity", "reserved"]`
Lena Ortiz: also let's not forget SDK snippets. i found python examples still using `reserved_capacity=True`. propose we add a migration note in /docs/migration/sdk-params.md and update all snippets to the canonical `deployment` string enum. small shim code shown in migration doc.
Marco Ruiz: sample shim for Python snippet to include in migration doc:
```python
# temporary shim (v2 -> v3)
def _normalize_kwargs(kwargs):
    if kwargs.pop('reserved_capacity', False):
        kwargs.setdefault('deployment', 'dedicated')
    return kwargs
```
Priya Shah: excellent. add a deprecation message text too: "Deprecated: 'reserved_capacity' will be removed in v4 (6 months). Use 'deployment' instead." include in migration doc and in SDK changelog blurb.
docs-ci-bot: Auto: opened PR #4792 to add voice.md, linter rule, and link redirects (https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4792).
Maya Li: timeline? i can open the link-fix PR today (include redirects), Marco can land voice.md by EOD tomorrow, Priya will add lint rules in a separate PR. Lena will coordinate and approve.
Lena Ortiz: sounds good. final ask: when making snippet changes, keep both python snake_case and JS camelCase examples. also please add a single-line note in relevant pages: "See migration guide: /docs/migration/sdk-params.md"
Marco Ruiz: LGTM. closing once PR #4792 and the link fixes are merged. thanks everyone :party_popper:
